alternative_assessment: Renaming to.bin or adding.gitattributes would not change this classifier. Changing global encoding/chardet would change unrelated text handling and does not provide a precise binary declaration. Do not prepend NUL or alter archive bytes.
mechanism: First NUL at byte1165 lies outside original1024-byte classifier; original is_text_file returns true even with.bin suffix. Encoding fallback then reads the compressed shard as Latin1. There is no extension, MIME or Git-attributes declaration path in that classifier.
minimal_patch: One bounded pre-Codespell identity guard followed by one exact existing-style skip entry. Missing original shard is not applicable; nonregular, wrong length or different SHA is failure. Existing skip patterns, dictionaries, action pin, other files and all experiment gates stay unchanged.
qualification_effect: None: binary spell-check classification only; no experiment/native/source/lint pass or authority is granted.
version_scope: Action pin is fixed, but requirements allow codespell>=2.2.4; actual failing job installed2.4.3. This review analyzes that observed version, not every possible future version.
